title: DDK forum interface and mass leads screened for the 964/993 monocoque

rights.attribution: DDK; discovery through the PorscheFanatics forum-measurement index

notes: Fifteen selected facts from nine original posts were checked against the PorscheFanatics dataset and read in their original threads. The dated bridge at twins/964-chassis/ddk-interface-bridge-20261104/ retains URLs, private-page hashes, original summaries and context links to the 18 manual point identities and seven scan search regions. Original page access verifies the presence and context of claims, not their physical accuracy. No new donor XYZ, tunnel surface, measured mass, load input or compatibility is accepted. The 1972 engine spacing, SC/964/930 conversion offset and early-transmission hatch are excluded from 964 geometry. Raw pages, images and member identities remain private; no redistribution or training licence is granted. The missing Celette drawing and unconfirmed generation prevent importing its reported Z values.
